say:3:1460130001:0.text: How was it? Although I lost, I felt that my cooperation with Antandra was great!
say:3:1460130001:0.source_cn: 怎么样怎么样？虽然输了，但我感觉和安丹德拉配合就是非常顺畅！

say:4:1460130002:0.text: Indeed, Miss Satrana. Your magic walks a different path... unique, like a fire that dances to its own rhythm.
say:4:1460130002:0.source_cn: 是的，萨忒娜小姐你的魔法和我所见到的其他魔法又有所不同...

say:5:1460130003:0.text: Though cloaked in the garb of magic, you fight like stone and flame... strong in defense, swift in assault. You are no stranger to close combat.
say:5:1460130003:0.source_cn: 既能进攻，又能护身，因此你看似是法师，却能轻巧地参与近...

say:6:1460130004:0.text: And Miss Antandra complements you well. She is ever watchful of your movements.
say:6:1460130004:0.source_cn: 而这位安丹德拉女士则正好与你相得益彰，她时刻注意着你的步伐。

say:7:1460130005:0.text: Her shield, used with balance, strikes to shatter the foe's line and protects you like a wall of stone against surprise attacks.
say:7:1460130005:0.source_cn: 寓攻于守的盾击不仅能在危急时打开通路，更能时刻为你抵挡...

say:8:1460130006:1.text: So, we're the perfect partners! What do you think, Antandra? Do you have the heart to watch me fight alone?
say:8:1460130006:1.source_cn: 所以，我们就是最好的搭档，对吧，安丹德拉！你忍心看我孤...

say:9:1460130007:1.text: Alright, alright. If you really want to compete, count me in.
say:9:1460130007:1.source_cn: 好吧，好吧，如果你真这么想参赛，就算我一个。

say:10:1460130008:1.text: With clear reluctance, Antandra yields to Satrana's suggestion, and not far off, a hearty laugh echoes through the air.
say:10:1460130008:1.source_cn: 安丹德拉无奈地应和着萨忒娜的建议，不远处响起了豪爽的笑声。

say:11:1460130009:0.text: Kruger leads the way, followed closely by Brutus, Alsa, Soren, and Mikola. They seem to be holding a meeting.
say:11:1460130009:0.source_cn: 克鲁格一马当先，布鲁特斯和阿尔萨、索恩、曼卡拉他们紧随...

say:14:1460130010:1.text: We've been sitting here since your letter showed up, but who knew you'd be so eager to throw down right away? Ha!
say:14:1460130010:1.source_cn: 接到你们的信我们就在这里等着，没想到你们已经迫不及待地...

say:15:1460130011:1.text: How about we have a few spars first to warm up before we get down to talking?
say:15:1460130011:1.source_cn: 要不要先来打上几场，好好活动活动再聊？

choice_prompt:16:1460130011.text: How about we have a few spars first to warm up before we get down to talking?
choice_prompt:16:1460130011.source_cn: 要不要先来打上几场，好好活动活动再聊？

say:17:1460130012:0.text: Oh, it seems that you all have come up with a solution on your travels.
say:17:1460130012:0.source_cn: 哦？看起来你们离开这几天，已经想到确切的解决方案了吗？

say:18:1460130014:1.text: Everyone chimes in to explain the plan, which took shape little by little thanks to shared ideas and lessons learned along the way.
say:18:1460130014:1.source_cn: 于是，你们将这一路走来，集思广益，逐渐完善的计划娓娓道来。

say:19:1460130015:1.text: Through martial arts, bonds will be forged. Fighters from every corner will clash, sharing styles born of distant land, and the preliminary matches will unfold across the realm.
say:19:1460130015:1.source_cn: 以武会友，能体验各地各族不同战斗风格的大赛，遍地开花、...

say:20:1460130016:1.text: When it is revealed that several regions have already embraced the plan, a surge of excitement sweeps through everyone present.
say:20:1460130016:1.source_cn: 当你们介绍了已经接受你们邀请的几个地区后，在场的众人都...

say:23:1460130017:1.text: Real Graveborn and pirates! I've only read about them in books!
say:23:1460130017:1.source_cn: 居然还有亡灵和海盗……我只在书中才读到过的传奇角色！

say:24:1460130018:1.text: It would be absolutely amazing to see them here!
say:24:1460130018:1.source_cn: 如果能在这里见到他们，那绝对，绝对是最了不起的事！

say:25:1460130019:1.text: Although they're not Maulers, this is great news for our warriors!
say:25:1460130019:1.source_cn: 尽管已经不止是我们蛮血部落自身，但对我们的战士来说更是...

say:26:1460130020:1.text: I'm tired of these normal battles. It's time for new challenges!
say:26:1460130020:1.source_cn: 那些司空见惯的战斗早就腻了，是时候来点新鲜的挑战了！

say:27:1460130021:1.text: Yes, if this is successful, it might become more grand than the Warsong Festival!
say:27:1460130021:1.source_cn: 没错，如果能成功举办，说不定会比战歌节更热闹，更华丽，...

say:28:1460130022:0.text: It'll also boost trade everywhere and develop tourism in those locations!
say:28:1460130022:0.source_cn: 而且还能带动各个区域的商贸，甚至能发展旅游呢！

say:31:1460130023:1.text: With proper planning, it can even increase the income of the region.
say:31:1460130023:1.source_cn: 只要筹划得当，甚至还能增加收入。

say:32:1460130024:0.text: During this period, we have to make preparations, such as setting up inns and strengthening our security.
say:32:1460130024:0.source_cn: 那这段时间，我们还得做好准备，比如设置旅店，加强治安方...

say:33:1460130025:0.text: I think we can handle that later. There are more important questions!
say:33:1460130025:0.source_cn: 哎呀，那都是后续的事了，布鲁特斯大人！现在有个更重要的问题！

say:35:1460130027:0.text: What is the <style="highlight">name of this tournament</style>?
say:35:1460130027:0.source_cn: 这场大赛到底<style=highlight>叫什么名...

say:36:1460130028:0.text: We can't just keep calling it the martial arts tournament.
say:36:1460130028:0.source_cn: 总不能一直比武大会啦，武技大赛啦之类的乱叫一通吧？

say:37:1460130029:0.text: Since Graveborn and pirates are coming to participate, we need to come up with a name that's as impressive as the Warsong Festival!
say:37:1460130029:0.source_cn: 既然还有亡灵和海盗要参赛，那就要起一个和战歌节差不多威...

say:40:1460130030:1.text: Similar to the Warsong Festival... A tournament that you and Soren suggested...
say:40:1460130030:1.source_cn: 唔，和战歌节差不多，而且又是你和索恩提出的举行大赛……

say:41:1460130031:1.text: Since you two bear the Dusk's Blessing. How about calling it the Dusk Festival?
say:41:1460130031:1.source_cn: 你们两个身负残阳神的祝福，叫残阳节如何？

choice_prompt:42:1460130031.text: Since you two bear the Dusk's Blessing. How about calling it the Dusk Festival?
choice_prompt:42:1460130031.source_cn: 你们两个身负残阳神的祝福，叫残阳节如何？

say:43:1460130032:0.text: Hmmm... the Dusk Festival does sound too much like a Mauler holiday... Also, the word festival is used too often...
say:43:1460130032:0.source_cn: 唔，确实，残阳节听起来太具有我们蛮血部落的风味了，而且...
say:43:1460130032:0.male: Hmmm... the Dusk Festival does sound too much like a Mauler holiday... Also, the word festival is used too often...
say:43:1460130032:0.female: Hmmm... the Dusk Festival does sound too much like a Mauler holiday... Also, the word festival is used too often...

narration:46:1460130034:0.text: Surpassing the splendor of the evening sky, the sun shines with the unyielding radiance at its zenith.
narration:46:1460130034:0.source_cn: 超越残阳的颓废，犹如烈阳般挥洒灿烂的光辉……

narration:47:1460130035:0.text: Out in the open, under the blazing sky, anyone can show off their moves for all the world to see.
narration:47:1460130035:0.source_cn: 在这烈阳照耀下，在世界面前，肆意地演练自身的武艺吧——

choice_prompt:49:1460130035.text: Out in the open, under the blazing sky, anyone can show off their moves for all the world to see.
choice_prompt:49:1460130035.source_cn: 在这烈阳照耀下，在世界面前，肆意地演练自身的武艺吧——

say:50:1460130036:0.text: Holy Bloodclaw! That name's got fire in its veins! It'll be on every tongue before long!
say:50:1460130036:0.source_cn: 太棒了！这个名字真是又热血又灿烂！一定会广为流传的！

say:51:1460130037:1.text: Then, all the qualifiers at the different regions can have a generic name, but with the Sunlit Showdown blasted in front. It'll make registration easier.
say:51:1460130037:1.source_cn: 那么，各地的预选赛就根据这个名字起个统称——这样方便参...

say:54:1460130038:1.text: I have an idea. When one gives themselves to the temple life, one often travels to various places to learn and practice. This is called a pilgrimage.
say:54:1460130038:1.source_cn: 我倒是有个想法，在神庙修行时，常有前往过各地学习演练的...

say:55:1460130039:1.text: How about calling all the preliminary matches the "<style="highlight">Pugilist Pilgrimage</style>"?
say:55:1460130039:1.source_cn: 不如各地的预选赛，就统称为<style=highlig...

say:56:1460130040:1.text: What a name! This sounds more like a meeting place for warriors to come together and celebrate the art of battle!
say:56:1460130040:1.source_cn: 很合适！不像挑战或者比赛之类的那么功利，更有以武会友的...

narration:57:1460130041:1.text: With the name now chosen, you all launch once more into a fiery debate, refining the schedule and sharpening every detail of the plan.

choice:16:0:1.text: We'll have time to fight later.
choice:16:0:1.male: We'll have time to fight later.
choice:16:0:1.female: We'll have time to fight later.

say:59:1460130013:1.text: Could it be that you all have already come up with a plan in such a short time? Yes, tell us.
say:59:1460130013:1.source_cn: 难道说你们这么短的时间内，已经有了章程？快说来听听吧。

choice:16:1:2.text: Let's get down to business first.
choice:16:1:2.male: Let's get down to business first.
choice:16:1:2.female: Let's get down to business first.
